findings: Exact-labelled scan groups positive-size candidates by encoded size, then images by 256-pixel system-thumbnail pixel-buffer SHA256 and videos by only the first 256 KiB SHA256. Neither path performs full encoded-byte confirmation, so this is not exact-file equality.

Video openInputStream returning null becomes nonempty signature video-partial- rather than failure, allowing same-size unreadable videos to group. This is source-derived, not Android runtime reproduction.
Signature cache validation uses path/id, modification time and encoded size, with no explicit algorithm/version/color recipe key. Database entity/DAO implementation remains unread.

Cache cleanup deletes entries outside allScannedPaths, but that set contains only same-size candidates in this invocation. Unique-size or out-of-scope paths can lose cached signatures; this may be deliberate cache pruning but is not evidence of deleted files.
Cancellation checks exist, but broad Exception catches in hashing catch cancellation too; final cancellation propagation and cache-write behavior require coroutine runtime inspection.

PHashUtil is horizontal 9x8 dHash with BT601-style RGB luminance and strict greater-than bits. Alpha ignored; system scaling/color semantics unspecified. Hamming validates length and BigInteger parsing but does not explicitly reject signed 16-character values.

DuplicateFinderUseCase imports domain.model.DuplicateGroup, while the separately read usecase/DuplicateGroup is a different hash-named model. Actual imported model remains unread; no compile failure inferred.
